To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel robust federated learning method with MPC privacy guarantees that is scalable with the number of participating clients.

we propose an efficient federated averaging method with MPC guarantees on the multi- silo setting that is robust to a variety of failures and attacks, and we prove that the proposed federated averaging method converges robustly.

(1) federated averaging is vulnerable to adversarial updates from the clients, (2) the naive MPC median is scalable only for a few clients, (3) our proposed approximate median aggregation with secure MPC privacy guarantees is scalable for a large number of clients, and (4) the convergence rate of federated learning is robust to a large number of failures and adversarial attacks

the following question: Can we achieve robust and scalable federated learning in the multi-silo setup with provable security guarantees against semi-honest adversaries?
the development of a robust federated learning method that is scalable and has provable privacy and security guarantees.

we propose a scalable robust federated learning method with provable privacy guarantees.
we propose a scalable federated averaging method with privacy guarantees and convergence guarantees against a variety of failures and attacks.
the proposed method is a scalable, robust and provably secure aggregation method for federated learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an efficient and provably robust federated learning method for a wide range of failure and adversarial scenarios.
we present the first robust federated learning method with MPC privacy guarantees that can scale to a large number of clients.
we provide the first provable secure federated learning method that is scalable to large number of clients.
The main takeaway from our work is that
federated averaging can be made robust and scalable with privacy guarantees.
federated learning can be made robust and private, even with a small number of participating clients.
federated learning with provable security guarantees can be achieved at a reasonable cost.
